description: This is a Python source file demonstrating a personalized voice agent example using Pipecat, Mem0 integration, and various speech and memory services. It sets up a conversational AI with memory capabilities, including personalized greetings based on stored memories, multi-modal interaction, and different memory management approaches (cloud-based Mem0 API and local configuration). The code defines functions for initializing the conversation, managing memory retrieval, and running the bot pipeline with event handlers.
